sections.content:
Colleva provides AI avatar-led sales coaching, professional skill development, and employee insights at scale.
To truly excel, employees need more than just technical know-how; they need robust hard and soft skills. Together, these skills amplify productivity, fortify morale, and cultivate loyalty. Yet, honing them isn't always straightforward. These skills often are underdeveloped because of a lack of mentorship opportunities, challenges arising from hybrid and remote work environments, and the steep costs of executive coaching or other learning models.
We believe the next generation of technologies can address these challenges and provide personalized experiences at scale.

sections.heading: Job description:
sections.content:
Our team is always looking for amazing talent – be it those passionate about helping others improve, great engineers, or others interested in the future of beneficial AI.
Colleva has opportunities in product, marketing, frontend and backend development, and AI/ML research.
If you’re interested in joining the effort, simply fill out this application and we’ll reach out if there’s a good fit!
Colleva, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
